text: Make human-approved aim proposals reachable from ordinary text entry
description: Expose a lean product entry point where a human enters a goal, receives a transient one-root AimProposal, decomposes it with the existing recursive editor, reviews it, and explicitly persists it. This delivers a usable no-model baseline while keeping the proposal contract ready for later model-backed decomposition and voice reuse.

status.comment: The ordinary-text → editable proposal → explicit approval path is implemented and internally verified; awaiting Felix's UI acceptance.

reflection: Added a toolbar “New goal” entry point and AimProposalEntry. Ordinary text becomes a transient one-root proposal (no graph write), then opens the recursive editor/review surface. Cancelling review returns to text entry; successful approval reloads all aims, switches to graph view, and selects the durable root. This is a usable no-model baseline and preserves the same contract for later model/voice input. Verification: entry+review tests 5/5, full frontend tests 204/204, frontend type-check, production build, and git diff check.
